events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese 87th Birthday
angles.copy: He's responsible for some of the greatest British comedy moments ever. We're tipping our bowler hat to John Cleese as he turns 87.

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled "The Beatles" but known as the "White Album", was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped their epic 'White Album'. Still sounds as revolutionary today as it did back in '68.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 and would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. A true rock icon.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A game-changer for The Beatles and for music itself. 'Rubber Soul' hit the shelves 61 years ago today, cementing their creative evolution.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember musician and activist John Lennon, who was tragically killed in 1980 and would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the iconic musician, artist, and innovator David Bowie.

angles.name: David Bowie 80th Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of the Starman himself, David Bowie. Forever missed, never forgotten.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Presley 92nd Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Ninety-two years since the birth of the one and only Elvis Presley. The King's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page 83rd Birthday
angles.copy: A true guitar wizard. Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page of Led Zeppelin.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod Stewart 82nd Birthday
angles.copy: The unmistakable voice and charisma of Rod Stewart. He's celebrating his 82nd birthday today!

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs 66th Birthday
angles.copy: Our house, in the middle of our street... it's Suggs from Madness's 66th birthday! What a legend.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)", celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young 71st Birthday
angles.copy: The voice behind some of the greatest 80s hits. Happy 71st birthday to the one and only Paul Young!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country music, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Parton 81st Birthday
angles.copy: Working 9 to 5 and still looking fabulous! Happy 81st birthday to the incredible Dolly Parton.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary Barlow 56th Birthday
angles.copy: From boyband heartthrob to national treasure. Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow!

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British R&B and soul singer Billy Ocean, known for global hits like "Caribbean Queen", celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean 77th Birthday
angles.copy: When the going gets tough, the tough get celebrating! Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and The Beatles.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame First Induction
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years since the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. A monumental day for music history, celebrating the absolute legends.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer-songwriter Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark Owen 55th Birthday
angles.copy: The boyband charm is still going strong! Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Concert
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the roof for their final gig. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Singer, songwriter, and drummer Phil Collins, known for his solo hits and work with Genesis, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil Collins 76th Birthday
angles.copy: Another year older, but still 'Against All Odds'. Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins!

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor and romantic comedy favourite Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Hugh Grant 67th Birthday
angles.copy: The charming Hugh Grant turns 67 today. Still making us swoon and laugh in equal measure.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake 46th Birthday
angles.copy: He's bringing sexy back, and another year older! Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles as Del Boy and Pop Larkin, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: David Jason 87th Birthday
angles.copy: What a plonker! Just kidding, it's Sir David Jason's 87th birthday today. A true national treasure.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event famously known as "The Day The Music Died".

angles.name: The Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, whose music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s hits and recent resurgence, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Rick Astley 61st Birthday
angles.copy: He's never gonna give you up, and he's turning 61 today! Happy birthday to the legendary Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Today would have been the 82nd birthday of the iconic reggae musician Bob Marley.

angles.name: Bob Marley 82nd Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: The king of reggae, Bob Marley, would have been 82 today. His message of love and unity continues to inspire.
